idea-plugin.name: Kreft
idea-plugin.description:
Support for Kreft .kreft component files (and .kreftjs files from the 0.0.x betas) in WebStorm, PhpStorm, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, RubyMine, GoLand, Rider and Android Studio.

  • Colors and completion: a .kreft file is opened as HTML, so the <view> markup, the CSS in <style> and the JavaScript in <script> are highlighted and completed.
  • Emmet: type ul>li.item*3 in <view> or m10, df in <style> and press Tab.
  • Live templates: kreftjs, state, action, for, kreft-wait and more, then Tab.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0: the first version. .kreft files as HTML, Emmet, live templates.
